----------**Leader Buff**---

_finalhealer_ task:
	killed 4 _healer_

_leaderbuffcheck_ task:
	injured _spells_

	
_leaderheal_ task:
	when _leaderbuffcheck_ and not _finalhealer_
	pick one of _noBuff_ _noBuff_ _noBuff_ _noBuff_ _noBuff_ _Heal_ _Shield_ _Shield_ _Specail_
	setvar _leaderbuff_
	clear _leaderheal_
	

_noBuff_ task:
	clear _noBuff_
	
_Heal_ task:
	cast Heal spell on _spells_
	clear _Heal_

_Shield_ task:
	cast Shield spell on _spells_
	clear _Shield_
	
_Specail_ task:
	cast Invisibility spell on _spells_
	cast Iron_Will spell on _spells_
	clear _Specail_

    cast Spell_Reflection spell on _spells_
